item.summary: The Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme (CMPS) with budgetary outlay of Rs.10,000 crore upto FY 2039-40 envisages to establish a globally competitive container manufacturing ecosystem in India, reduce import dependence and strengthen supply-chain resilience. item.title: Cabinet approves Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme
